implementation.targetScope: VentiMath's English date displays, local date arithmetic, relative timestamps and unchanged MUI DateTimePicker AdapterDateFns API. Plain Date values and en-US only; not the full date-fns locale, FP, UTCDate/TZDate or context surface.

changes: Independent implementation from public APIs, application caller inspection and black-box comparisons. No upstream runtime copied or runtime dependencies.
Bounded format-token cache shared by formatting and field parsing; no dynamic code generation.
Month arithmetic clamps day-of-month, day arithmetic follows local calendars, and hours/minutes/seconds advance elapsed time.
ISO and picker parsing reject impossible calendar dates; timezone behavior uses the runtime's maintained timezone data rather than fixed geographical offsets.

caller.scope: Issues, calendar events, notes/reminders, notifications, messenger, mailbox, profile and the root MUI AdapterDateFns/enUS provider. Fixtures use MUI X Date Pickers 8.7.0 and React 19.3.1. Private application source is not shipped; adoption remains separate.
